reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Matched wild-type versus kinase-dead K rescue in K-loss cells; proposed orthogonal confirmation assessed where used.

checks.reason: No explicit prior Methods/supplement/validated-protocol consultation and detailed condition-transfer verification before execution.

No unstimulated/ligand vehicle arm and no non-targeting editing control in the allocated core panel. Parental empty vector does not control editing or establish ligand-dependent increments across genotypes.

checks.quote: We also assume ligand-induced signaling directly drives
checks.reason: The assay assumes signaling mediates growth without an S-directed test. It also treats pooled KO association as necessity and noncatalytic rescue as a specific scaffold mechanism.
No cell authentication/contamination/passage checks or full rescue-construct identity verification; sequencing only the KO locus does not establish these prerequisites.

checks.quote: Transfect cells according to the allocation scheme
checks.reason: No transfection amount/dose, target-cell number, exposure/expression timing or concrete procedure to choose them; medium/starvation settings remain generic calibration promises.
No quantitative phospho-assay standard/dilution/specificity and accuracy acceptance/failure gate.
No background, low/absent denominator, saturation or missing-measurement rule; metabolic viability and net cell count alone do not distinguish division from death.
Repeat thaws/cultures from a shared clone do not replicate genotype derivation. No independent editing/rescue replication count with precision/power justification.

checks.quote: fails to show a statistically significant reduction
checks.reason: Stopping/replacing a valid KO solely because its phenotype is nonsignificant selects against biological nonresponses; it is not an outcome-independent technical failure.
No biological nesting, ligand interaction, effect uncertainty or equivalence test for the required WT-KD comparison; post-hoc mean comparisons do not establish equal rescue.
Matching limited-proteolysis patterns cannot establish identical tertiary structure or preserved specific scaffold interactions; it is a coarse structural proxy.
No bounded ligand/delivery/time exploration and prespecified stopping/lock; selecting maximal response can obscure partial rescue and is not a defined nonsaturated sensitivity design.
Mutation/tag/degron changes are not followed by an explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation plan.

The primary gate never directly measures KD catalytic inactivity, residual activity or relevant partner binding/localization; abundance and folding alone cannot isolate catalysis in the decisive rescue rule.
No operational independent catalytic perturbation. A degron removes both catalytic and scaffold functions and only supplies another loss-of-protein test.
No raw-file/sample/code/settings/version audit trail.

However direct inactivity/scaffold qualification is missing and coarse folding evidence is over-read. Controls, independent replication and executable measurement/statistics are incomplete.
